breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to ignore the product of inertia (I_yz) and use a simplified superposition, which was incorrect for an unsymmetric bending problem. The ground truth removed this incorrect instruction. The generated specification also correctly omitted this erroneous instruction, instead directing the calculation to use the full unsymmetric bending formula which properly accounts for I_yz.
